Browser.Test.Title: Test the browser
Browser.Test.Desc: Starts the browser hidden, checks the manager can talk to it and closes it again. Use it when signing in through the browser fails.
Browser.Status.None: No supported browser found. Download the private browser below.
Browser.Cloak.Desc: CloakBrowser is a portable Chromium build. It's downloaded from its GitHub releases, checked against the published SHA-256 and kept in the data folder. Nothing is installed on Windows.

Chromium.Title: Download the private browser
Chromium.Body: CloakBrowser, a portable Chromium build, is downloaded once into the data folder and verified before it's used. It only opens your accounts and stays separate from your normal browser.

General.Language.Title: Display language
General.StartWithWindows.Desc: Opens the manager when you sign in to Windows.
General.StartMinimized.Desc: When started with Windows, stay in the system tray instead of opening the window.
General.CloseToTray.Desc: The close button hides the window so automation keeps running. Quit from the tray icon.
Appearance.Mode.Desc: System follows the light or dark setting of Windows.
Appearance.Accent.Desc: Used for primary buttons, focus rings and selection. Status colors don't change.
Appearance.Density.Desc: Compact fits more accounts on the screen.
Appearance.Colors.Desc: Fine-tune single colors of the current look. Changes apply right away.
Launching.Multi.Title: Allow multiple clients
Launching.Multi.Desc: Run more than one Roblox client at the same time.
Launching.Singleton.Title: Unlock clients started elsewhere
Launching.Singleton.Desc: Keeps releasing Roblox's single-client lock, so games started from the website open a new window too.
Launching.Adopt.Title: Track clients started elsewhere
Launching.Adopt.Desc: Clients opened from the website or the Roblox app count as running clients and playtime.
Launching.Delay.Title: Delay between accounts
Launching.Delay.Desc: Wait time when several accounts launch in a row. Very short delays can run into Roblox's rate limits.
Launching.CloseLast.Title: Close the older client
Launching.CloseLast.Desc: When an account launches again, its previous client is closed first.
Launching.Lowest.Title: Prefer emptier servers
Launching.Lowest.Desc: Smart join picks servers with fewer players instead of a random one.
Launching.Pages.Title: Server pages to scan
Launching.Pages.Desc: More pages find better servers but take longer. A page holds up to 100 servers.
Multi.AlreadyAdmin: The manager is already running as administrator.
Multi.Elevate.Title: Restart as administrator?
Multi.Elevate.Body: A Roblox client was started with higher rights, so its lock can only be released as administrator. The manager restarts; running clients keep running.
Graphics.Fps.Title: FPS cap
Graphics.Fps.Desc: Saved in Roblox's own settings before each launch, so it's the same value as the frame rate option inside Roblox.
Profile.UltraLowAfk.Desc: For accounts that only need to stay in a game. Choose it under Automation → select a preset → Performance profile, and switch off below whatever you want to keep. Roblox reads these settings when a client starts and shares them between all clients, so the profile applies to the clients launched with it and the next launch without it restores your normal settings.
Profile.Fps.Title: Frame-rate cap
Profile.Fps.Desc: Frame-rate cap for clients started with Ultra-low AFK. 0 keeps your normal cap. Roblox decides which values it accepts.
Profile.Minimize.Title: Minimize once in game
Profile.Minimize.Desc: Minimizes the client after it has joined its game; Roblox stops loading while minimized. Needs Show online status (Settings → Live data). Anti-AFK still reaches minimized clients.
Graphics.Fps.Unknown: Roblox uses its default frame rate.
Graphics.Fps.NoFile: Roblox hasn't created its settings file yet. Start any game once.
Graphics.Apply.Title: Apply FastFlags
Graphics.Apply.Desc: Writes the options below into every Roblox installation before launch.
Graphics.Api.Title: Graphics API
Graphics.Api.Desc: Direct3D 11 is the most compatible. Vulkan or OpenGL can help on some graphics cards.
Graphics.Quality.Title: Graphics quality
Graphics.Quality.Desc: Locks the quality level. Automatic lets Roblox adjust it.
Graphics.Msaa.Title: Anti-aliasing
Graphics.Msaa.Desc: Smooths edges. Higher values cost more GPU time.
Graphics.Texture.Title: Texture quality
Graphics.Texture.Desc: Lower quality saves video memory when many clients run.
Graphics.Dpi.Title: Ignore display scaling
Graphics.Dpi.Desc: Renders at full resolution on high-DPI screens.
Graphics.Grass.Title: Hide grass
Graphics.Grass.Desc: Removes terrain grass for a higher frame rate.
Graphics.Sky.Title: Gray sky
Graphics.Sky.Desc: Replaces the sky with plain gray.
Graphics.Voxel.Title: Freeze lighting
Graphics.Voxel.Desc: Pauses lighting updates to save CPU. Light no longer changes during play.
Graphics.AltEnter.Title: Exclusive fullscreen with Alt+Enter
Graphics.AltEnter.Desc: Alt+Enter switches to exclusive fullscreen, which can lower input lag.
Graphics.Custom.Title: Custom flags
Graphics.Custom.Desc: A JSON object with more flags. Flags that aren't on Roblox's allowlist are skipped and listed here.
Graphics.AllowlistNote: Since September 2025 Roblox only accepts FastFlags from its official allowlist. Unsupported flags are skipped automatically, so a change to the list never breaks launching.
FFlags.InvalidJson: This isn't valid JSON. Check the quotes, commas and braces.
FFlags.NothingWritten: There were no flags to write. Turn on at least one option.
FFlags.Clear.Title: Remove the FastFlag files?
FFlags.Clear.Body: Deletes the ClientAppSettings.json files in your Roblox installations. Roblox then uses its defaults.
FFlags.NoneToClear: There were no flag files to remove.
AntiAfk.Title: Keep clients active
AntiAfk.Desc: Sends a short key press to every Roblox window so games don't kick idle accounts.
AntiAfk.Interval.Desc: How often every client gets a key press.
AntiAfk.Random.Desc: Each client waits a random time between the interval above and this maximum, so several clients don't all get their key press at once.
AntiAfk.Key.Desc: The key that's pressed. Pick one the game doesn't use.
AntiAfk.Focus.Desc: Switch back to the window you were using after each round.
AntiAfk.Test.Desc: Sends one round to all running clients now.
AntiAfk.Sent.One: Sent a key press to {0} client.
AntiAfk.Sent.Other: Sent a key press to {0} clients.
Watchdog.Title: Rejoin after crashes
Watchdog.Desc: Relaunches accounts with rejoin turned on when their client closes unexpectedly. After several crashes in a row it waits longer between tries, up to 15 minutes, but keeps trying.
Watchdog.Interval.Desc: How often running clients are checked.
Watchdog.Disconnect.Title: Rejoin after a disconnect
Watchdog.Disconnect.Desc: Restarts a client whose account has stopped showing as in game, for example after a network drop left it on an error screen. Needs Show online status, and only covers accounts with rejoin turned on.
Watchdog.Restart.Title: Restart clients regularly
Watchdog.Restart.Desc: Closes and relaunches each client after it has run this long, one at a time, into the same game and server type. Gives games that slowly use more memory a fresh start.
Watchdog.Disconnected: {0} isn't in a game any more. Restarting it.
Ram.Monitor.Title: Watch memory use
Ram.Monitor.Desc: Measures how much memory each Roblox client uses.
Ram.Kill.Title: Force-close clients above
Ram.Kill.Desc: Ends a client's process once its memory use passes this number. This is a hard shutdown, not a memory limit: the game closes without saving and auto-rejoin doesn't bring it back.
Ram.Trim.Title: Trim memory every
Ram.Trim.Desc: Asks Windows to page out memory clients aren't using right now. Clients load it back as soon as they need it, so this frees RAM for a while but doesn't lower what Roblox needs. Trimming often can make clients stutter.
Hotkeys.ClickToRecord: Click, then press the new shortcut
Hotkeys.NeedModifier: A global shortcut needs Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win.
Hotkeys.Note: Global shortcuts also work while another program is in front. Press Esc while recording to cancel.
LiveData.Presence.Title: Show online status
LiveData.Presence.Desc: Asks Roblox regularly whether each account is online or in a game.
LiveData.Poll.Title: Refresh every
LiveData.Poll.Desc: How often the online status is refreshed.
LiveData.Avatars.Title: Show avatars
LiveData.Avatars.Desc: Loads each account's avatar picture from Roblox.
LiveData.Robux.Title: Show Robux
LiveData.Economy.Title: Load inventory value
LiveData.Economy.Desc: Loads the RAP of collectibles. Slower with many accounts.
Playtime.Track.Title: Track playtime
Playtime.Track.Desc: Records how long each account plays. The data stays on this PC.
Playtime.Status: {0} in total, {1} in the last 7 days
Playtime.Clear.Title: Delete the playtime history?
Playtime.Clear.Body: Every recorded session of every account is deleted. This can't be undone.
Playtime.ClearedFileLocked: The history was cleared, but its file couldn't be deleted. Close other copies of the manager and try again.
Proxy.Enable.Title: Use a proxy
Proxy.Enable.Desc: Sends Roblox web requests of all accounts through a proxy. Accounts with their own proxy use that one.
Proxy.Address.Title: Proxy server
Proxy.Address.Desc: http, https or socks5. A username and password can be part of the address or entered below.
Proxy.Invalid: Use a format like http://host:port or socks5://host:port.
Proxy.Note: The Roblox game client itself can't use a proxy. This setting covers the manager's own requests and its browser windows.
Security.Password.Desc: Encrypts the account file with your password and lets you lock the manager. Without one, Windows protects the file for your Windows user.
Security.Password.SetBody: You'll need it every time the manager starts. It can't be recovered, so keep it somewhere safe.
Security.Password.RemoveBody: The account file goes back to Windows encryption, and locking is turned off.
Security.AutoLock.Title: Lock when idle
Security.AutoLock.Desc: Locks after the PC has had no mouse or keyboard input for this long.
Security.LockOnMinimize.Title: Lock when minimized
Security.LockOnMinimize.Desc: Locks when the window is minimized or hidden in the tray.
Security.LockNow.Title: Lock now
Security.Clipboard.Title: Clear copied secrets
Security.Clipboard.Desc: Cookies, tokens and 2FA codes are removed from the clipboard after this time and never go to the clipboard history.
Security.HideNames.Title: Hide usernames
Security.HideNames.Desc: Masks names while you share or record your screen.
Security.Audit.Title: Audit log
Security.Audit.Desc: Records sensitive actions, like copying a cookie or using the web API, in audit.log.
Security.Validate.Title: Check sessions at startup
Security.Validate.Desc: Asks Roblox whether each saved session is still valid.
Security.Rotation.Title: Keep refreshed cookies
Security.Rotation.Desc: Roblox sometimes replaces a session cookie during launch. The new cookie is saved automatically.
Security.CheckNow.Title: Check all sessions
Security.CheckNow.Desc: Marks expired sessions so you can sign in to them again.
Security.StorageNote: Accounts are saved in accounts.dat in the data folder. Every cookie is encrypted on its own, and then the whole file is encrypted again.
Backup.Title: Encrypted backup
Backup.Desc: A password-protected file with all accounts that you can restore on another PC.
Backup.Nothing: There are no accounts to back up.
Backup.Password.Title: Protect the backup
Backup.Password.Body: The backup contains the session of every account. Choose a password with at least {0} characters. Without it the backup can't be restored.
Backup.Save.Title: Save backup
Backup.Open.Title: Choose a backup
Backup.Unlock.Title: Unlock backup
Backup.Unlock.Body: Enter the password the backup was created with.
Backup.RestoreFailedBody:
The backup couldn't be opened: {0}

Check the password, and that the file is a Roblox Account Manager backup.
Notify.Toasts.Title: Show notifications
Notify.Toasts.Desc: Short messages in the corner for launches, errors and finished tasks.
Notify.Launch.Title: Launches
Notify.Crash.Title: Crashes
Webhook.Url.Title: Discord webhook
Webhook.Url.Desc: Posts account events to a Discord channel. Only discord.com webhook links are accepted.
Webhook.Invalid: This isn't a Discord webhook link. It starts with https://discord.com/api/webhooks/.
Webhook.EnterFirst: Enter a Discord webhook link first.
Webhook.Connect.Title: Joins and rejoins
Webhook.Connect.Desc: Post when an account joins a game or is relaunched after a crash.
Webhook.Crash.Title: Crashes
Webhook.Crash.Desc: Post when a client closes unexpectedly.
Api.Enable.Title: Turn on the web API
Api.Enable.Desc: Lets scripts on this PC list, launch and close accounts over HTTP. It can't be reached from other computers.
Api.Port.Title: Port
Api.Token.Title: Access token
Api.Token.Desc: Send it with every request as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Treat it like a password.
Api.TokenGenerated: New token created. Update your scripts.
Api.TokenCopied: Token copied. It's removed from the clipboard shortly.
Api.NoToken: There's no token yet. Turn the web API on first.
Api.Cookie.Title: Allow reading cookies
Api.Cookie.Desc: Turns on GET /cookie. Anything with the token could then take over your accounts, so leave this off unless a tool needs it.
Api.Endpoints.Desc: Launching and closing need POST. Requests sent by web pages are refused.
Plugins.Enable.Title: Turn on plugins
Plugins.Enable.Desc: Loads plugin DLLs from the plugins folder.
Plugins.Enable.Body: Plugins are programs that run inside the manager with full access to your accounts and sessions. Only turn this on for plugins you wrote yourself or fully trust.
Plugins.Folder.Title: Plugins folder
Plugins.Folder.Desc: Put plugin DLL files here. A changed DLL needs a restart.
Plugins.Note: Plugins implement the IRamPlugin interface. The README describes it.
Updates.UpToDate: {0} is the latest version. Checked at {1}.
Updates.RateLimited: GitHub's limit for update checks is reached. Try again after {0}.
Updates.RateLimitedShort: Update check limit reached. Try again later.
Updates.Skipped: {0} is available, but you skipped it.
Updates.SkipCleared: The skipped version will be offered again.
Updates.Skipped.Title: Skipped version
Updates.Auto.Title: Check automatically
Updates.Auto.Desc: Looks for updates in the background at this interval.
Updates.Startup.Title: Check at startup
Updates.Startup.Desc: Looks for a new version every time the manager starts.
Updates.Pre.Title: Include pre-releases
Updates.Pre.Desc: Also offer test versions before they're final.
Updates.Verify.Title: Verify downloads
Updates.Verify.Desc: Checks the size and SHA-256 checksum before installing. Keep this on.
Updates.Keep.Title: Keep the previous version
Updates.Keep.Desc: Lets you roll back from here if an update causes problems.
Updates.Backup.Title: Previous version
Updates.Rollback.Title: Roll back to {0}?
Updates.Rollback.Body: The manager closes, {0} is restored and started again. Your accounts and settings stay as they are.
Updates.Skip.Tip: Don't offer this version again. Newer versions are still offered.
Updates.Installed: The update was installed. Here's what changed.
Updates.NotesUnavailable: This build has no changelog included, and GitHub couldn't be reached. Open the release page instead.
Updater.Title: Updating to {0}
Updater.WaitingForApp: Waiting for Roblox Account Manager to close…
Updater.Retrying: The connection dropped. Trying again ({0} of {1})…
Updater.Untouched: Your current version is untouched. Try again, or keep using it.
Updater.UntrustedSource: The update was refused because it doesn't come from the official GitHub release.
Updater.NotAnExe: The download isn't a Windows program. GitHub may have returned an error page.
Updater.ChecksumMismatch: The download doesn't match the checksum published with the release.
Updater.ReplaceFailed: The app file couldn't be replaced after {0} attempts. Close every copy of the manager and try again.
Diagnostics.Health.Empty: Run the check to test the Roblox installation, launch links, the connection to Roblox and the data folder.
Diagnostics.Log.Title: Diagnostics log
Diagnostics.Manager.Title: Manager memory use
Diagnostics.CopyReport.Desc: Copies versions, settings switches and the recent log for a GitHub issue. Cookies, passwords, tokens, webhooks and private-server codes are removed.
Diagnostics.Copied: Diagnostic report copied. Secrets were removed; account names from the log may remain, so read it before posting.
Diagnostics.Data.Title: Data folder
Diagnostics.Roblox.Title: Roblox installation
